name: MGallery Hanoi Hotel de L'Opera
positioning: Opera-themed MGallery hotel (officially Hotel de l'Opera Hanoi - MGallery) on Trang Tien Street, adjacent to the Hanoi Opera House
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base near the Opera House and Hoan Kiem Lake
Guests who enjoy theatrical, opera-inspired interiors

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Hanoi, within walking distance of the Hanoi Opera House, the Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem Lake and the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre.
The hotel is on Hanoi's historic Trang Tien Street.
Hoan Kiem Lake is 0.1 km from the hotel.
Trang Tien Plaza is 0.1 km from the hotel.
The hotel's opera theme is carried into every corner, bringing operatic and theatrical flair to the interior design.
Inspired by the neighboring Opera House, rooms feature velvet upholstery, dark timber floors, jewel-toned fabrics and artwork drawn from the performing arts.
Bathrooms have illuminated mirrors that evoke backstage dressing rooms.
Wellness facilities include a semi-outdoor heated pool, Harmonie Spa, a sauna and a 24-hour fitness center.
Lautrec is the hotel's glass-roofed French brasserie, set in a dramatic atrium.
La Fee Verte is the hotel's absinthe bar.

highlights.text: The hotel sits adjacent to the Hanoi Opera House.
Working with Vietnam's National Archives, the hotel reproduced the Opera House's original architectural blueprints as artwork displayed throughout the property.
The opera theme runs through every corner of the hotel, bringing operatic and theatrical flair to the interior design.
The semi-outdoor heated pool and terrace look toward the Opera House and Trang Tien Street.

considerations.text: The Hanoi Old Quarter is 1.1 km from the hotel, a walk rather than right outside the door.
The rooms are deliberately theatrical, with velvet upholstery and jewel-toned fabrics, rather than a minimalist look.
WhataHotel notes the busy downtown location can bring street noise.
